caution: Publicly observed records do not establish that SoilWise consumes file.json or that EUSO independently indexes ECHO. The M40 date must be backed by September 2026 records; modern test runs cannot prove historical compliance.

items.subject: Published Zenodo v12 record
items.claim: Zenodo record 23784504 is a published, open ECHOREPO dataset (version 12, published 2026-10-30), carrying six canonical CSV files plus file.json.
items.next_evidence: Retain dated Zenodo REST metadata response and file listing with DOI, license and checksums. Independently compare publication resources with the validated snapshot; do not assume byte equality.

items.subject: CSVW file.json consumption by SoilWise
items.claim: Zenodo visibly hosts file.json, but its parsing or use by SoilWise or EUSO has not been demonstrated.
items.next_evidence: Inspect SoilWise's dataset metadata display/XML or documented harvesting mapping for fields unique to file.json; request confirmation and raw metadata provenance from SoilWise.

items.subject: SoilWise harvest of ECHOREPO record
items.claim: The project reports that its Zenodo dataset is discoverable on SoilWise; no exact independent SoilWise record permalink has yet been attached to this evidence package.
items.next_evidence: Provide the exact public SoilWise record URL or its metadata export showing DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23784504 (or a clearly identified version). Capture record date, source repository and field mapping.

items.subject: EUSO indexing/harvest of ECHOREPO
items.claim: SoilWise documentation describes integration and migration to EUSO, but does not establish independent indexing of this particular ECHOREPO DOI in an EUSO catalogue.
items.next_evidence: Obtain a JRC/EUSO record URL, testable API response or signed technical confirmation that identifies ECHOREPO DOI and data flow.

items.subject: Firebase and external dependency operations
items.claim: Live API/PostgreSQL/Keycloak/MinIO and browser checks do not by themselves validate Firebase ingestion, external publication, all access controls or actual Zenodo upload operation.
items.next_evidence: Obtain separate read-only logs from relevant staging/production pipelines, release inventories, owners and authorized acceptance criteria.

items.subject: Formal requirements baseline and WP sign-off
items.claim: Technical tests are not a substitute for an approved Grant Agreement/D5.1 requirements-to-component mapping and assigned owner acceptance.
items.next_evidence: Attach exact GA/D5.1 version and clause references, approved component inventory, issue dispositions, named approvers and signed acceptance date.

items.subject: M40 September 2026 historical baseline
items.claim: November 2026 tests cannot retroactively prove deployment, conformity and testing at M40 (2026-09-30).
items.next_evidence: Retrieve immutable September 2026 release SHA, dated snapshots, test/deployment logs, documented requirements and change history.
